title: Location values fields
text:
Location values fields

Validation rules for fields related to the values associated with a
 location.

Select an exposure view, a contract in the contract list, the 
Contract
 Details
 pane, and then the location.

| Field | Description | Validation rules | Default value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display Currency | Currency for the display of financial values. To view supported
 currency codes, log in to the Developer Zone on the Client Portal . Then navigate to the Touchstone area, click the Touchstone Databases link (under Database
 Documentation ), and then search for " tCurrency
 Table . The Description field for the Currency Code column lists the ISO 3-character
 code for each currency. | Read-only | |
| Total Replacement Value | Total replacement value (all coverages combined) of this
 location. | Must be a numeric value between 0 and 999999999999999,
 inclusive. Not applicable for workers' compensation locations. | |
| Replacement Value Building | Total replacement value of all the buildings that this location record
 covers. Enter the actual value. Alternatively, enter 0 if the building is not covered. Note
 the following special cases: For the Great Britain and Germany Inland Flood models, if the floor of interest is not 0, this field represents the
 replacement value of the floor of interest only and not of the whole
 building. For the Europe Extratropical Cyclone model, if the country is Norway (8), Sweden (9), or Finland (89), the occupancy code is 375 - Forestry ,
 and you do not provide a building replacement value, Touchstone uses the gross area value in conjunction with the per-hectare
 forestry unit price values to determine the replacement value. For workers' compensation policies, enter 0 . For the U.S. Hurricane Plate Glass Module, enter the total
 replacement value of all the glass in the building. | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface. Must be a numeric value between 0 and 999999999999999, inclusive. Not applicable for workers' compensation locations. | 0 |
| Replacement Value Other | Total replacement value of all appurtenant structures that this location
 record covers, such as outbuildings, sheds, gazebos, etc. Enter the actual
 value or the insurance-to-value assumption as a decimal greater than or
 equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1. For example, enter 0.12 for 12%. Alternatively, enter 0 if other structures are not
 covered. Touchstone does not support this field for workers' compensation policies, offshore
 platform policies, and the U.S. Hurricane Plate Glass Module. Enter
 0. | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface. Must be a numeric value between 0 and 999999999999999,
 inclusive. Not applicable for workers' compensation locations. | 0 |
| Replacement Value Content | Replacement value of contents that this location record covers. Enter
 the actual value or the insurance-to-value assumption as a decimal
 greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1. For example,
 enter 0.12 for 12%. Alternatively, enter 0 if contents are not covered. Note the
 following special cases: For the Great Britain and Germany Inland Flood models, if the floor of interest is not 0, this field represents the
 replacement value of the contents in the floor of interest only and
 not of the contents in the rest of the building. Touchstone does not support
 this field for workers' compensation policies, offshore platform
 policies, and the U.S. Hurricane Plate Glass Module. Enter 0. | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface. Must be a numeric value between 0 and 999999999999999, inclusive. Not applicable for workers' compensation locations. | 0 |
| Replacement Value Time | Yearly cost for all time element coverage for the risks that this
 location record covers. Enter the actual value. Alternatively, enter 0 if time element is not covered. The value
 should correspond to the time indicated in the Replacement Value Days
 Covered field. For example, if the per diem business
 interruption value is $10,000, enter 10,000 in the Replacement Value Time field and 1 in
 the Replacement Value Days Covered field. Alternatively, enter the
 yearly business interruption value 3650000 in this
 field and 365 in the Replacement Value
 Days Covered field. Both entries will produce identical
 results. Touchstone does
 not support this field for workers' compensation policies, offshore
 platform policies, and the U.S. Hurricane Plate Glass Module. Therefore,
 enter 0 . | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface. Must be a numeric value between 0 and 999999999999999, inclusive. Not applicable for workers' compensation locations. | 0 |
| Replacement Value Days
 Covered | Number of days for which the replacement value time is in effect. For example, if the
 replacement value time is per diem, enter 1 . If
 the replacement value time is an annual total, enter 365 . Touchstone divides the replacement
 value time by the replacement value days covered. Consequently, you can
 select any number between 1 and 365, inclusive, that generates the best
 estimate of a per diem payout. Touchstone does not support this
 field for offshore platform policies. Therefore, enter 0 . | Required if you are creating a new record or editing an existing
 record. Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 365, inclusive. Not applicable for workers' compensation locations. | 365 |
| Number of Employees | Number of covered employees at this location. Enter 0 if you want to use the annual payroll and average annual wage instead of this field. For aggregate
 Japan Personal Accident data, you should always supply a value for this
 field. | Required if you are creating a new record or editing an existing
 record for a location in Japan (i.e., for locations with a country
 code of JP). Required if annual payroll is null. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999999999, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | NULL |
| Annual Payroll | Total annual payroll for all covered employees at this location. If
 you provide the number of employees , enter 0 for this
 field. | Required if number of employees is null. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999999999, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | NULL |
| Average Annual Wage | Average wage for all covered employees at this location. The Touchstone default value for this
 field is the state average. To use default values when importing
 data, leave this field empty in the *.csv import
 file. During installation you can upgrade to the latest AIR default values when you
 upgrade the AIR Exposure
 database. If you do not upgrade to the latest AIR default values, the
 values in AIR Exposure
 remain consistent with the vintage of the database. | Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
 interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
 delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
 defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration Console. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999999999, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | Default |
| Percent Day Shift | Percent of employees on premises at this location during the day shift,
 that is, during normal working hours (9 a.m. - 4:59 p.m.). For locations
 in the United States (i.e., for locations with a country
 code of US), enter the percentage as a decimal greater than or
 equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1. For example, enter 0.12 for 12%. Touchstone assumes that this
 percentage of employees will be at this location for eight hours per
 day. For locations in Japan (i.e., for locations with a country
 code of JP), enter the percentage as a number greater than or equal to 0
 and less than or equal to 100. To use default values when importing
 data, leave this field empty in the *.csv import
 file. During installation you can upgrade to the latest AIR default values when you
 upgrade to the latest AIR Exposure database. If you do not upgrade to the latest AIR default values, the
 values in AIR Exposure
 remain consistent with the vintage of the database. | Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
 interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
 delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
 defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration Console. For locations in the United States (i.e., for locations with a
 country code of US), must be a numeric value between 0.00 and 1.00,
 inclusive. For locations in Japan (i.e., for locations with a country code of
 JP), must be a numeric value between 0.00 and 100.00, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | Default |
| Percent Evening Shift | Percent of employees on premises at this location during the evening
 shift, that is, during typical commute times (7 a.m. - 8:59 a.m., 5 p.m. -
 6:59 p.m.). Enter the percentage as a decimal greater than or equal to 0
 and less than or equal to 1. For example, enter 0.12 for 12%. Touchstone assumes that this
 percentage of employees will be at this location for four hours per
 day. Touchstone ignores
 this field for the Japan Personal Accident model. To use default
 values when importing data, leave this field empty in the *.csv import file. During installation you
 can upgrade to the latest AIR default values when you
 upgrade to the latest AIR Exposure database. If you do not upgrade to the latest AIR default values, the
 values in AIR Exposure
 remain consistent with the vintage of the database. | Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
 interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
 delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
 defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration
 Console. Must be a numeric value between 0.00 and 1.00, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | Default |
| Percent Night Shift | Percent of employees on premises at this location during the night shift
 (7 p.m. - 6:59 a.m.). Enter the percentage as a decimal greater than or
 equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1. For example, enter 0.12 for
 12%. Touchstone assumes
 that this percentage of employees will be at this location for 12 hours
 per day. To use default values when importing data, leave this
 field empty in the *.csv import file. During
 installation you can upgrade to the latest AIR default values when you
 upgrade to the latest AIR Exposure database. If you do not upgrade to the latest AIR default values, the
 values in AIR Exposure
 remain consistent with the vintage of the database. | Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
 interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
 delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
 defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section section of the Administration Console. Must be a numeric value between 0.00 and 1.00, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | Default |
| Medical and Indemnity Minor | Average medical and indemnity payment rate for minor (outpatient for
 Japan) injuries, applicable for medical and indemnity payments. To use
 default values when importing data, leave this field empty in the *.csv import file. During installation you
 can upgrade to the latest Touchstone default values when you
 upgrade to the latest AIRExposure database. If you
 do not upgrade to the latest default values, the values in AIRExposure remain consistent with the vintage of
 the database. | Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
 interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
 delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
 defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration Console. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999999999, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | Default |
| Medical and Indemnity Moderate | Average medical and indemnity payment rate for moderate (hospitalization
 and surgery for Japan) injuries, applicable for medical and indemnity
 payments. To use default values when importing data, leave this field
 empty in the CSV import file. During installation you can upgrade
 to the latest Touchstone default values when you upgrade to the latest AIRExposure database. If you do not upgrade to
 the latest default values, the values in AIRExposure remain consistent with the vintage of the database. | Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
 interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
 delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
 defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration Console. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999999999, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | Default |
| Medical and Indemnity Major | Average medical and indemnity payment rate for major (disability for
 Japan) injuries, applicable for medical and indemnity payments. To use
 default values when importing data, leave this field empty in the CSV
 import file. During installation you can upgrade to the latest Touchstone default values
 when you upgrade to the latest AIRExposure database.
 If you do not upgrade to the latest default values, the values in AIRExposure remain consistent with the vintage of
 the database. | Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
 interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
 delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
 defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration Console. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999999999, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | Default |
| Medical and Indemnity Fatality | Average medical and indemnity payment rate for fatal (death for Japan)
 injuries, applicable for medical and indemnity payments/ To use default
 values when importing data, leave this field empty in the CSV import
 file. During installation you can upgrade to the latest Touchstone default values when you
 upgrade to the latest AIRExposure database. If you
 do not upgrade to the latest default values, the values in AIRExposure remain consistent with the vintage of
 the database. | Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
 interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
 delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
 defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration Console. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999999999, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations. | Default |
| Number of Risks | Number of risks for this location record. Touchstone does not support this
 field for offshore platform policies. For loss calculation, this
 field is informational and does not have an impact on modeled
 losses. | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999,999,999, inclusive. | 1 |
| Per Diem Rate | Per diem time element replacement value for this location. The per
 diem time element replacement value calculation for each location is the replacement value time divided by replacement value days covered . | Read only Must be a numeric value between 0 and 999999999999999, inclusive | |
| Premium | Total premium for this location, that is, the sum of the written
 premiums for all the risks that this record covers. Touchstone does not use this field in
 analyses. | Optional | 0 |

Average Annual Wage

Average wage for all covered employees at this location. The Touchstone default value for this
                           field is the state average. To use default values when importing
                           data, leave this field empty in the *.csv import
                           file. During installation you can upgrade to the latest AIR default values when you
                           upgrade the AIR Exposure
                           database. If you do not upgrade to the latest AIR default values, the
                           values in AIR Exposure
                           remain consistent with the vintage of the database.

Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
                              interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
                              delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
                              defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration Console. Must be a numeric value between 1 and 999999999, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations.
Default
Percent Day Shift

Percent of employees on premises at this location during the day shift,
                        that is, during normal working hours (9 a.m. - 4:59 p.m.). For locations
                           in the United States (i.e., for locations with a country
                              code of US), enter the percentage as a decimal greater than or
                           equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1. For example, enter 0.12 for 12%. Touchstone assumes that this
                           percentage of employees will be at this location for eight hours per
                           day. For locations in Japan (i.e., for locations with a country
                           code of JP), enter the percentage as a number greater than or equal to 0
                           and less than or equal to 100. To use default values when importing
                           data, leave this field empty in the *.csv import
                           file. During installation you can upgrade to the latest AIR default values when you
                           upgrade to the latest AIR Exposure database. If you do not upgrade to the latest AIR default values, the
                           values in AIR Exposure
                           remain consistent with the vintage of the database.

Optional To use a default workers' compensation value for this field in the Touchstone user
                              interface, you can either not enter a value in the field or you can
                              delete an existing value for the field. If you leave the field blank, Touchstone uses the loss
                              defaults specified in the Wages and Benefits section of the Administration Console. For locations in the United States (i.e., for locations with a
                              country code of US), must be a numeric value between 0.00 and 1.00,
                              inclusive. For locations in Japan (i.e., for locations with a country code of
                              JP), must be a numeric value between 0.00 and 100.00, inclusive. Only applicable for workers' compensation locations.
Default

                           this field for the Japan Personal Accident model. To use default
